resources.name: Iron Ore
resources.notes: Common industrial feedstock. High-volume, low-prestige, strategically essential.

resources.name: Titanium Ore
resources.notes: Light, strong and valuable for aircraft, spacecraft and high-performance structures.

resources.name: Silicate Aggregate
resources.notes: Bulky and cheap. Transport distance strongly affects construction economics.

resources.name: Carbon Feedstock
resources.notes: Industrial carbon stream used across civilian and military production.

resources.name: Rare-Earth Concentrate
resources.notes: Low-volume resource with disproportionate influence on advanced systems.

resources.name: Fissile Feedstock
resources.notes: Strategically controlled because energy infrastructure depends on it.

resources.name: Water Ice
resources.notes: Especially valuable away from temperate worlds.

resources.name: Hydrogen
resources.notes: A major interplanetary energy and propulsion feedstock.

resources.name: PlasCrete Mix
resources.notes: The ordinary material of bases. Cheap, massive and everywhere.

resources.name: Refined Reactor Fuel
resources.notes: A keyed logistics product. It is not interchangeable with ordinary fuel.
